strategy_roster.name: XAU/USD ADX Bollinger
strategy_roster.notes: Bollinger(20,2) and ADX(14)>25 provide explicit fallback filters for the undocumented band/strength settings. The gold-specific symbol, opposite-band side, and any unlisted exit parameters are not represented.

strategy_roster.name: Supertrend Target Stop
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(14) plus 3 ATR(14) is a SuperTrend-line proxy, with the documented fixed 0.01% stop and target retained. The exact SuperTrend state, ATR multiplier implementation, and opposite side are approximated.

strategy_roster.name: Long and Short with Multi Indicators
strategy_roster.entry_long: rsi(close,5) > 44 and rsi(close,5) < 70 and roc(close,4) > 0 and close > sma(close,24)
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(5) range, ROC(4), and SMA(24) retain the documented long momentum conditions. TEMA, bearish MA-duration filtering, and the ATR(14) trailing stop are not directly expressible; the short branch is omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Keltner Rsi
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(20) plus/minus 2 ATR(14) approximates Keltner bands and preserves the lower-band/RSI(14)<30 long setup. The explicit 2% stop is retained; the exact channel and short branch are not modeled.

strategy_roster.name: TRAYLERv
strategy_roster.notes: This legacy trade manager explicitly does not open positions, so the impossible guard preserves that behavior. Fractal stop/target maintenance, pending-order cleanup, and manual-position state are outside the indicator DSL.

strategy_roster.name: AIS2 Trading Robot
strategy_roster.notes: A prior 20-bar high break with ADX(14)>20 approximates the primary-timeframe directional breakout. Secondary-timeframe trailing, range factors, portfolio budgets, and tick buffers cannot be represented.

strategy_roster.name: IU Range Trading
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > donchian_high_prev(high,10) and high - low <= 1.75 * atr(high,low,close,14)
strategy_roster.notes: A prior 10-bar high break while the bar stays within 1.75 ATR(14) approximates the narrow-range breakout condition. The ATR target factor 2.0 is dynamic, and trailing-stop state cannot be encoded.

strategy_roster.name: DreamBot
strategy_roster.notes: ROC(13) zero-line direction and ADX(14)>20 approximate the Force Index bullish threshold and momentum confirmation. Force Index smoothing, explicit point stops/targets, and trailing-start state are not available.

strategy_roster.name: EA Template
strategy_roster.notes: The latest completed candle body supplies the documented non-reversed long/short direction, with the opposite body as the signal exit. Reverse mode, spread gate, money management, and point protection require unsupported state.

strategy_roster.name: CBC_WS_RSI
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and roc(close,1) > 0 and roc(close,2) > 0 and rsi(close,37) < 40
strategy_roster.notes: Three bullish ROC steps approximate Three White Soldiers while RSI(37)<40 retains the long confirmation ceiling. The documented 1% stop and 2% target are retained; exact candlestick detection and short permissions are omitted.
